rationale: Extend the existing reasoning engine with one topic-specific waiting_period ASSESS_APPLICABILITY rule after frozen falsification proved routing already reaches NO_APPLICABLE_RULE cleanly. The rule consumes existing governed waiting-period component types, produces only an unresolved conditional implication when customer-specific elapsed-time, continuity, or exception facts are absent, and does not add product-specific runtime logic or DERIVE_IMPLICATIONS handling.
supersession_impact: No existing rule or capability is superseded. Existing factual and conditional co-payment rules remain unchanged.
authority_impact: No new claim-payment, eligibility, or recommendation authority is introduced. The rule explicitly withholds a case-specific applicability conclusion when approved customer facts are insufficient.
